This document outlines the testing procedure I1, which must performed every six 
months as indicated by M6 in the title block.

This patent concerns the test of Protection 
Relays of home transformer, manufactured by SKODA and ABB ARAB. The 
transformer is of type KTRT 18X20, rated power 20MVA, vector group Dd0, and 
voltages 15.75 8x2%/6.3KV.

The first draft initiated by 
eng. Maysa Ahmady, tested at 27 Jan.2003 by eng. Iman Rizk El-Ashry, revised by EDEPCo. quality 
control engineer eng. Adel Abdel Kader EL Nagar, accepted by general 
director eng. Mahmoud Sakr, and approved by eng. Mustafa Allam Talkha Power 
Station Sector Head
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety class,

Safety fence with caution marks & 
no smoking signs surrounding 
the work area is required,

Make sure that 
CT secondary circuits are shorted before isolating the current circuits for test 
transformer protection scheme.

The test of all main transformer protection devices is 
achieved by isolating either CT circuits or PT circuits or both.

This is 
done by using a special socket for testing. This makes the test results depend 
only on the action of relays

Differential of Unit 
1BT10, R43X1,SKODA for 
( Generator + Transformer )

It is a 3-point differential protection with a measuring 
member in each phase locked switching on surge

items: Place the socket ZZ10 in Z10 (TA 9/1)(HH01)

Inject the current on points (11,12,13,14(N)) of Z10 either phase - phase or 
 phase - neutral
Fix the timer leads to (172,197) at the rear of panel HH02

Increase the current till the red flag of the device displays and the timer 
 closes (almost instantaneously)
Repeat the test for each case and record both the current and tripping time
Place the socket ZZ10 in Z17 (TA1/2 & TA5/3)(HH01)
Inject the current phase - phase on Z17 for each current transformer
Repeat the steps 3 to 5
Place a socket ZZ10 in Z10 and another one the Z17

Inject the current on the neutral of Z10 and a phase of Z17 (TA1/2) then 
 (TA5/3)
Repeat the steps 3 to 5
Record the results

Comparison Protection (Pilot ) 
F52
 , TYPE S103, S105

This protection is a differential protection on the Transmission Line between transformer 1ATO,
(15.75/220kv) and B.B. GIS, restricted by operation of over current 
F51 on that TL .

items: Place the socket ZZ10 in XJ2 in HS01

Inject the current on points (11,12,13,14(N)) of XJ2 either phase - phase or 
 phase - neutral
Increase the current gradually till the red flag of the device displays
Repeat the test for the different cases of injection
Record the current value in each case
Place the socket ZZ10 in XJ1 in HS01
Inject the current on points (11,12) then (13,14) and finally (15,16) of XJ1
Increase the current gradually till the red flag of the device displays
Repeat the test for each cases of injection
Record the results

The protection measures voltage of the generator neutral against the earth. At 
earth connection Ug=0 takes place and the protection acts

items: Place the socket ZZ10 in Z1 (HH01)
Inject the voltage in phase R & the neutral of TV 3/1
Fix the timer leads to (172,195) at the rear of panel HH05

Increase the voltage gradually till the red flag of the device displays. At 
 this moment, make the timer start acting till it stops indicating the 
 signaling time.
Record the voltage and time
Place the special testing socket of the device in its place in HS01
Fasten the tester leads in (A3,A4) of the socket

Increase the injected voltage gradually till the red flag of the device 
 displays
Record the value of the voltage
Place the socket ZZ10 in X01 (TA5/4) in HS07
Inject the current to points (3,4,5) of Z01 phase to phase

Increase the injected current gradually till the red flags of the injected 
 phases display. The timer closes instantaneously
Record the values of current and time values in the test sheet
Repeat the previous steps to points (3,4,5) of Z02 phase to phase in HS07
Record the values of current and time values in the test sheet.

Repeat the previous steps to points (1,2,3) of Z04 - operating coil - phase to 
 phase in HS07
Record the values of current and time values in the test sheet.

Release the leads 
 of the testing instruments.

Check the return of relay- wires and 
 trip-leads to their original places and tighten them carefully.

Press the main RESET button in HH01 for 
 those devices in the control room.

Be sure that the relay is completely ready for 
 service any time.

Alienate (push out) the testing materials and equipments 
 in addition to the caution signs and leave the place clean.
Return the work permission.

text:
Protection
Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the testing procedure I1, which must performed every six 
months as indicated by M6 in the title block.
This patent concerns the test of Protection 
Relays of home transformer, manufactured by SKODA and ABB ARAB. The 
transformer is of type KTRT 18X20, rated power 20MVA, vector group Dd0, and 
voltages 15.75 8x2%/6.3KV.
The first draft initiated by 
eng. Maysa Ahmady, tested at 27 Jan.2003 by eng. Iman Rizk El-Ashry, revised by EDEPCo. quality 
control engineer eng. Adel Abdel Kader EL Nagar, accepted by general 
director eng. Mahmoud Sakr, and approved by eng. Mustafa Allam Talkha Power 
Station Sector Head
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety class,
Safety fence with caution marks & 
no smoking signs surrounding 
the work area is required,
Make sure that 
CT secondary circuits are shorted before isolating the current circuits for test 
transformer protection scheme.
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety class,
Safety fence with caution marks & 
no smoking signs surrounding 
the work area is required,
Wear 
 safety helmet, safety shoes
Make sure that 
CT secondary circuits are shorted before isolating the current circuits for test 
transformer protection scheme.
Ascertain the disconnection of the exciter, generator, main transform and home transformer
Be aware of 
 parts in service.
Follow the work 
 permission instructions.
Tools and Equipment
An AC voltage source of type Z11.
An AC 
 current source of type Z11
An ammeter & A voltmeter.
A timer unit TM-2 ( Program )
Some leads & 
 screws.
Work to be Carried Out
Relay Preparation
Review 
 the manual.
Prepare 
 the previous results of the relay testing.
Check 
 the wires of the relay beforehand.
Be sure that the unit and the transformer are disconnected and 
 the d.c. source is available.
Check 
 the existence of the 
 d.c. sources in panels.
Disconnect the trip leads of the relay and connect the timer to them.
Check 
 all the leads used in tests.
Test Tools Preparation
Connect the testing units of Z11 to a power source
Connect the timer to a power source and its terminals to the trip terminals of 
 the relay under test
Place an ammeter on current leads of Z11 to measure the 
 current.
Connect the voltmeter in parallel with the voltage leads of 
 Z11 ( the other unit ) to measure the voltage.
The test of all main transformer protection devices is 
achieved by isolating either CT circuits or PT circuits or both.
This is 
done by using a special socket for testing. This makes the test results depend 
only on the action of relays
Testing 
Procedures
Differential of Unit 
1BT10, R43X1,SKODA for 
( Generator + Transformer )
It is a 3-point differential protection with a measuring 
member in each phase locked switching on surge
Test Steps
C.T. TA 9/1,TA1/2 10.000/5A
Place the socket ZZ10 in Z10 (TA 9/1)(HH01)
Inject the current on points (11,12,13,14(N)) of Z10 either phase - phase or 
 phase - neutral
Fix the timer leads to (172,197) at the rear of panel HH02
Increase the current till the red flag of the device displays and the timer 
 closes (almost instantaneously)
Repeat the test for each case and record both the current and tripping time
Place the socket ZZ10 in Z17 (TA1/2 & TA5/3)(HH01)
Inject the current phase - phase on Z17 for each current transformer
Repeat the steps 3 to 5
Place a socket ZZ10 in Z10 and another one the Z17
Inject the current on the neutral of Z10 and a phase of Z17 (TA1/2) then 
 (TA5/3)
Repeat the steps 3 to 5
Record the results
Short Circuit In Neutral, 
A22X1
It is a one - phase over current protection suitable e.g. for locking of earth 
fault protection GF1XIby the earth current of very high voltage
CT TA6/1 750/5A (1st unit)
TA6/1 1000/5A (2nd unit)
Test Steps
Place the socket ZZ10 in Z5 (TA6/1) (HH01)
Inject the current in points (11,12(N)) of Z5
Fix the timer leads to (172,195) at the rear of panel HH05
Increase the current gradually till the red flag of the device displays. At 
 this moment, make the timer start acting till it stops indicating the 
 signaling time
Record the current and time
Tank Protection type A33TX1, 
F17
It is a three phase / RST / over current protection with distinguishing of the 
effected phase with a time member
It is a protection device for short circuit protection of 
the body of tank this operate if any earth fault happened on the body itself .
Test Steps
Place the socket ZZ10 in Z6 (HH01)
Inject the current on points (11,12(N)) of Z6
Fix the timer leads to (172,196) at the rear of panel HH02
Increase the current gradually till the red flag of the device displays. At 
 this moment, make the timer start acting till it stops indicating the tripping 
 time
Record the current and time
Comparison Protection (Pilot ) 
F52
 , TYPE S103, S105
This protection is a differential protection on the Transmission Line between transformer 1ATO,
(15.75/220kv) and B.B. GIS, restricted by operation of over current 
F51 on that TL .
Test Steps
Place the socket ZZ10 in XJ2 in HS01
Inject the current on points (11,12,13,14(N)) of XJ2 either phase - phase or 
 phase - neutral
Increase the current gradually till the red flag of the device displays
Repeat the test for the different cases of injection
Record the current value in each case
Quick Acting Relay (Pilot) type A15
Test Steps
Place the socket ZZ10 in XJ1 in HS01
Inject the current on points (11,12) then (13,14) and finally (15,16) of XJ1
Increase the current gradually till the red flag of the device displays
Repeat the test for each cases of injection
Record the results
Earth Fault Protection type GF1TX1
The protection measures voltage of the generator neutral against the earth. At 
earth connection Ug=0 takes place and the protection acts
Test Steps
Place the socket ZZ10 in Z1 (HH01)
Inject the voltage in phase R & the neutral of TV 3/1
Fix the timer leads to (172,195) at the rear of panel HH05
Increase the voltage gradually till the red flag of the device displays. At 
 this moment, make the timer start acting till it stops indicating the 
 signaling time.
Record the voltage and time
Restricted Ground Fault type RADHD,
Test Steps
Place the special testing socket of the device in its place in HS01
Fasten the tester leads in (A3,A4) of the socket
Increase the injected voltage gradually till the red flag of the device 
 displays
Record the value of the voltage
Differential of AT10 type RAX1
Test Steps
Place the socket ZZ10 in X01 (TA5/4) in HS07
Inject the current to points (3,4,5) of Z01 phase to phase
Increase the injected current gradually till the red flags of the injected 
 phases display. The timer closes instantaneously
Record the values of current and time values in the test sheet
Repeat the previous steps to points (3,4,5) of Z02 phase to phase in HS07
Record the values of current and time values in the test sheet.
Repeat the previous steps to points (1,2,3) of Z04 - operating coil - phase to 
 phase in HS07
Record the values of current and time values in the test sheet.
Returning the Relays to Service
Release the leads 
 of the testing instruments.
Check the return of relay- wires and 
 trip-leads to their original places and tighten them carefully.
Press the main RESET button in HH01 for 
 those devices in the control room.
Be sure that the relay is completely ready for 
 service any time.
Alienate (push out) the testing materials and equipments 
 in addition to the caution signs and leave the place clean.
Return the work permission.
